answers.core: Ideally, this would be incorporated into the inspector for the Control node itself, not added on as a separate field, which I think is what would have to happen in an add-on. It would also interact closely with the Control node code and its existing properties.
answers.workaround: As stated above, I think the calculation itself is relatively trivial, but having to include a script with it on every node that I want to exhibit this behavior seems like it would be quite unwieldy. If the node has a main purpose, then in my mind the script attached to it should be dedicated to that purpose.

title: Option to provide Control pivot offset as ratio of size
